docker_gateway_mode.description: Explicitly opt into detecting the actual Docker bridge or configure docker_host_gateway manually. No address is prefilled.

skip_tls_verification.description: Historical environment field; omitted means false and old records remain readable. New format-3 runs use separately approved network profiles, not this field. Does not relax model HTTPS, SSH host checks, Docker daemon/pulls or original Dockerfile/verifier.

docker_gateway_mode.description: Explicitly opt into detecting the actual Docker bridge or configure docker_host_gateway manually. No address is prefilled.

skip_tls_verification.description: Historical environment field; omitted means false and old records remain readable. New format-3 runs use separately approved network profiles, not this field. Does not relax model HTTPS, SSH host checks, Docker daemon/pulls or original Dockerfile/verifier.

NetworkProfile.description: Explicit host-scoped network settings, no inherited proxy/mirror/CA/TLS defaults. Public profile metadata is immutable per revision; proxy credential values are never included. Configuration selection does not prove every connection succeeded.

tls_risk_accepted.description: Server-derived confirmation for this exact saved revision. Every edited skip-mode save requires confirm_tls_risk; start additionally requires independently hash-bound scope confirmation.

proxy_password.description: Stored as plaintext only in the permission-restricted local SQLite database; never returned. Omit/null to retain this field. Use clear_credentials to clear active and historical values; this is not cryptographic disk erasure.

proxy_username.description: Stored as plaintext only in the permission-restricted local SQLite database; never returned. Omit/null to retain this field. Use clear_credentials to clear active and historical values; this is not cryptographic disk erasure.

NetworkSnapshot.description: Frozen public source/build/agent/verifier/model profiles and independent credential revisions included in the format-3 approval hash. No proxy credential values. Original Dockerfile build and verifier checks are not relaxed.

api_key.description: Stored as plaintext in the private local SQLite database. Omit/null to retain; empty string clears active and historical credential values. Clearing is not cryptographic disk erasure.

agent_version.description: Historical reports only. Omit for new runs: Harbor uses its default container installation and the actual CLI version is independently observed before inference. Nonempty values in new run requests are rejected.

controlToken.description: Ephemeral local control token delivered by the native Desktop bridge, not a model provider API key.

info.description: Loopback-only read-only results; authenticated Desktop control and explicit host-scoped network configuration. Provider and proxy credentials are write-only plaintext in the user's permission-restricted SQLite database. Format-3 approval freezes network revisions without secrets. Separate TLS-scope confirmations do not replace hash-bound paid start approval. One explicit task and no implicit paid reruns.
